status: candidate frozen references; derived and cross-checked by the author TASK, not yet independently refuted
theory: small-displacement linear-elastic Euler-Bernoulli space frame, no shear deformation, St Venant torsion GJ with J = 2I; annular section, Iy = Iz = I

conventions.support_reaction: global action of the support on the structure at its node (moments about that node)
conventions.section_action: element-local action on the +x face of the i-side portion at station s/L (local x from i to j); a node-on-element end action is -section(0) at end_i and +section(1) at end_j
conventions.local_axes: x from i to j; y = y_reference less its x part; z = x cross y

criterion: |observed - expected| <= 1e-9 * |expected|; an exactly zero expectation uses 1e-9 * zero_scale of its family (largest nonzero magnitude of that family in the case)
